source.company_summary: NVIDIA has a platform strategy, bringing together hardware, systems, software, algorithms, libraries, AI models and training data sets, and services to create unique value for the markets we serve.
product_stack: NVIDIA DRIVE stack for autonomous driving
NVIDIA AI Enterprise software – essentially an operating system for enterprise AI applications
end-to-end platform spanning data center infrastructure
end-to-end accelerated computing platform for AI

gaming: GeForce RTX GPUs for gaming desktop

ai_exposure.summary: Data Center The NVIDIA Data Center platform is focused on accelerating compute-intensive workloads, such as AI, data processing, graphics, robotics, and scientific computing, delivering superior total cost of ownership relative to conventional CPU-only approaches.

strategy_changes.change: In 2023, we introduced our first data center CPU, Grace, built for giant-scale AI and high-performance computing, or HPC.

In 2024, we launched the NVIDIA Blackwell architecture – connecting 36 Grace CPUs and 72 Blackwell GPUs in a data center scale, liquid-cooled design – for real-time trillion-parameter inference and training.

translation.company_summary: NVIDIA 採用平台策略，結合硬體、系統、軟體、演算法、函式庫、AI 模型與訓練資料集，以及服務，為我們服務的市場創造獨特價值。
product_stack: NVIDIA DRIVE 堆疊用於自動駕駛
Omniverse 用於實體 AI 應用
NVIDIA AI Enterprise 軟體——本質上是企業 AI 應用的作業系統
涵蓋資料中心基礎架構的端到端平台
用於 AI 的端到端加速運算平台

gaming: GeForce RTX 用於遊戲桌機的 GPUs

ai_exposure.summary: 資料中心 NVIDIA 的資料中心平台專注於加速計算密集型工作負載，如 AI、資料處理、圖形、機器人技術及科學運算，與傳統僅使用 CPU 的方法相比，提供更優越的整體擁有成本。

strategy_changes.change: 2023 年，我們推出首款資料中心 CPU Grace，專為巨型規模 AI 與高效能運算（HPC）打造。
2024 年，我們發表 NVIDIA Blackwell 架構——在資料中心規模設計中搭配 36 顆 Grace CPUs 和 72 顆 Blackwell GPUs，並採用液冷系統，支援實時兆參數推論與訓練。
